notes.title: Appeal of Developers about War in Ukraine
notes.content:
As you have probably already heard, Ukraine is currently at war with Russia after a massive Russian military attack on Ukraine. Russian military forces are bombing our cities and killing civilians. Big cities of Ukraine are covered in ruins. Hundreds of innocent people are injured every day, on purpose. Russians don't follow any international humanitarian laws. If we don't stop them now, they won't stop at the borders of Ukraine and will continue to attack the world. We must stop Russia before it's too late!

WE NEED YOUR HELP!

But how can you help?

1. Donate:
Our soldiers need something to eat and something to fight with. Innocent people who lost their homes due to rocket attacks on civilians need food and shelter. There are initiatives that raise money for food, ammunition, shields and uniforms for soldiers and civilians, which accept donations. Links to those initiatives are in this post. If you have the possibility - DONATE, HELP OUR PEOPLE! All of the money you spend on help will ensure your safety from Russian tanks in the long run.

2. Stay Informed
Keep yourself updated ONLY from verified and trusted sources of information. There is a lot of false information on the internet, so always double-check before taking something for truth. The links for verified official sources of information are in this post. And don't trust Russian information sources, which just spread misinformation to hide their actual actions. Spread this information among your relatives, use social media,  participate in peaceful protests to help Ukraine in your country. You can even join the foreign legion of territorial defence of Ukraine. Sigh petitions to urge your government to take action and support Ukraine. Please help us, SPREAD THE TRUTH!

The quicker we take action now, the sooner we will win!
